subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for benchmark-backed fallback ordering while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 owns model-input guardrails, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of a narrower fallback-policy issue?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but fallback ranking requires live benchmark/product policy and the guardrail half is already tracked separately, so automation should not choose the permanent tracking and policy contract alone.

options.title: Keep As Fallback Policy Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for the benchmark-backed fallback ordering decision and let the focused guardrail issue own schema/capability validation.

options.title: Open A Narrow Fallback Tracker
options.body: Create or identify one narrower fallback optimization issue, then close this broad follow-up as superseded once both halves have canonical homes.

options.title: Defer Fallback Policy Work
options.body: Leave current explicit fallback ordering as the product behavior and close or park this issue after documenting why benchmark ranking is not planned now.

recommendation.title: Keep As Fallback Policy Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the benchmark-backed fallback ordering decision and let the focused guardrail issue own schema/capability validation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined routing signal from the issue timeline plus fallback/provider-routing history.
